create_displaylinkplus.gui.label_templat: Put {} where the value goes, e.g. "{} items/s". Formats: {k} = 1.2k, {,} = 1,234, {.1} = 1 decimal

create_displaylinkplus.overlay.label: %s · %s
create_displaylinkplus.ponder.multi_link: A single Display Link can now write to several displays and lines
Each entry has its own information, display and line. The interface shows them as numbered tabs
Press + to add an entry on the next free line of the same display
To add another display, first right-click it with a Display Link...
...then right-click the existing link. The display is added as a new entry
Look at a link while holding a Wrench or wearing Goggles to see every display it writes to
Put {} in a label to place the value anywhere, e.g. "{} RS signal". {k} shortens large numbers to 1.2k
A Clipboard copies all entries of a link (right-click) and pastes them onto another link (left-click)
